newsitem.title: MACEDONIA: ONE COMPANY TRADES ON MACEDONIA STOCK EXCHANGE.
newsitem.headline: ONE COMPANY TRADES ON MACEDONIA STOCK EXCHANGE.

text.p: Stock turnover and traded volume rose at Tuesday's session of the Macedonian Stock Exchange (MSE), the MSE said.
Total turnover rose to 296,217 denars from 204,930 denars at the last session on September 12 and traded volume grew to 159 shares from 110.
Only Gradski Targovski Centar traded on the first floor, selling 159 stocks at 1,863 denars, unchanged from last trading and below par of 2,661 denars.

Listed companies trade in two floor sessions. Unlisted ones, mostly firms offered for privatisation, trade in a third floor session. The exchange trades twice a week. ($1=40.26 denars; 1DEM=26.61 denars)
